title: US single release: With A Little Luck by Wings | 1978
content:
Wings’ single ‘With A Little Luck’ was released in the USA on 17 March 1978.

It came out ten days ahead of the London Town album. The b-sides were ‘Backwards Traveller’ and ‘Cuff Link’.

‘With A Little Luck’ entered the Billboard Hot 100 at number 70 on 25 March, and topped the chart on 20 May. It remained there for two weeks, and spent a total of 18 weeks on the chart.

The single was released on 24 March in the UK.
